domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 在有限计算区域内通过循环更新处理长距离运行的方法。
usage_overview: 用于列车沿长线路运行的时域动力分析，通过局部与全局坐标或自由度映射，随车辆位置循环更新有限轨道计算区段、系统矩阵及响应状态，从而控制参与求解的模型规模，提高长距离响应计算效率。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: Moreover, a cyclic calculation method (CCM) is further developed to solve infinite length calculations.
Thus, a cyclic calculation method (CCM) is developed to properly handle these matters, as shown in Figure 3.
By introducing cyclic calculation method, infinite length calculation is achieved in this finite element model.
With this account, Xu and Zhai [31,32] had developed a class of cyclic calculation method (CCM) to solve this matter, which can be introduced in this work by further modifications.
To relieve the computer storage and save the CPU time for the large-scale VTT dynamics system with high degrees of freedoms, a cyclic calculation method is introduced.

Considering the high DOFs of the tunnel system, the cyclic calculation method proposed in [24] is introduced, where the track-tunnel system is truncated to reduce the DOFs of VTT system in the numerical integral solutions and accordingly, to improve the computational efficiency.

Aiming at the clarification of the spatial variability and correlation of track parameters on the influence of vehicle-track dynamic performance, a general scheme based on Karhunen–Loève Expansion and cyclic calculation method is developed to realize a multi- dimensional random field that holds an arbitrary marginal distribution function and correlation structure, and to consider the inhomogeneity of system parameters along the longitudinal direction efficiently.

Xu and Zhai [27] have proposed a cyclic calculation method (CCM) to solve this problem, which was further extended to achieve the stochastic dynamic analysis of the vehicle-track system considering the longitudinal non-uniformity of the geometric and physical parameters of track in this work.

At the same time, the cyclic calculation method is improved for the train system, and the efficient solution method of the train-rail-tunnel system dynamic model is pro posed by combining Green’s function.
For example, structures with weak band characteristics such as basement, tunnel and soil are not suitable for using the cyclic calculation method.
